verdict.rationale: DeepInfra advertises a zero retention policy for inputs, outputs and user data, backed by SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification. It also offers dedicated instances with a private endpoint for data isolation. This covers retention as a default posture, but the evidence shows no user-facing controls for setting retention or deleting data. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention settings, deletion APIs or account-level deletion controls, detailed retention policy documentation, and independent verification of the zero-retention claim.
